summary: Bad-gateway bug verification: PASSED. Full end-to-end verification from external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://plan-workspace.preview.emergentagent.com) shows the app is fully reachable through the k8s ingress. Zero 502/503/504 responses observed across page load, /api/, login (cookie + Bearer), jobs list, job detail, layout SVG, Leaflet map tiles+markers, PDF blob download, and post-reload session. Client and Reviewer logins both succeed and both roles see both seed jobs ('Watermain repair - Lonsdale Ave' approved, 'Signal upgrade - Marine Dr & Capilano Rd' pending review). LLM/generation flows intentionally not exercised per request.
critical_code_review_comments: Not part of this pass — bug scope was strictly gateway reachability (no LLM/plan generation).
test_credentials: client@tmait.ca / Client@1234, reviewer@tmait.ca / Review@1234 (both work end-to-end via cookie + Bearer)
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed jobs (Watermain repair, Signal upgrade).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gateway is healthy. If the user reports 'bad gateway' again, first check `supervisorctl status` — the preview pod idles and the very first request after wake can 502 for a few seconds until backend/frontend supervisor workers are RUNNING. Once services show RUNNING with >30s uptime, external URL serves 200 on /, /api/, /api/auth/login, /api/jobs, /api/jobs/{id}, /api/jobs/{id}/export (PDF), and static tiles.leaflet-tile requests. Note: correct PDF export route is GET/POST /api/jobs/{job_id}/export (not /export/pdf). Cookie httpOnly auth confirmed working through the ingress (/api/auth/me returns 200 with cookie set from /api/auth/login).
rca of the issue: User's 'bad gateway' report was consistent with the preview pod being cold — supervisor logs showed backend/frontend had just restarted (~50s uptime at time of complaint). During cold-boot the k8s ingress returns 502 until upstream FastAPI/CRA dev server bind their ports. All independent probes now show 200s and end-to-end user flows (login → jobs → plan document with citations → layout SVG → Leaflet map with 12 markers + 9 tiles → 153KB valid PDF download → reload session persistence via httpOnly cookie → reviewer role login) all succeed with 0 gateway errors captured by the Playwright response listener. No code change needed; issue resolved by pod being warm.
